title: Field-aware invert of a prior overwrite-mode PasteClips command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip overwrite-mode PasteClips of a copied left remnant onto a right remnant at 1s restores only that command's overwrite-paste write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later unrelated SetMarkers does not conflict: invert removes the pasted clip, restores the carved destination's start and duration, rebinds the leftover carved cue to clipLocal on that host, keeps the unmoved left remnant and its followed hello cue, and keeps the later markers and the unmoved stay cue. A later text edit of the leftover carved cue, or of the unmoved stay cue, also does not conflict; invert keeps the new text.

A later leave-gap MoveClip of the carved destination remnant, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. A later leave-gap out-trim of that remnant is not this slice's official conflict path, because it can change unrecorded sourceRange canonicity without being seen as a write-set conflict; invert may then refuse TIME_NON_CANONICAL, and this slice does not retarget that error code. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Leaf-level rational n/d granularity is unchanged. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP, and does not officialize insert PasteClips invert, SetDissolve invert, or auto-close of a vacated source gap. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered edit semantics including includeLinks=false MoveClips stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH. An overwrite that would uncover or crop a source cue remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. An overwrite that would overlap a followed cue and a dest remnant remains CAPTION_OVERLAP. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip and is not used on this path. Captions still do not enter the internal clipboard; invert does not claim to clear that package.

A real UI path splits at 1s, adds hello, carved, and stay cues, copies the left remnant, sets collision mode to overwrite, pastes at 1s, adds a later marker, inverts the PasteClips command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Extract is not required. Official later work is a marker or a text edit, not a later dest out-trim. Persist-path checks after archive/fork use caption text and anchors, the later marker label, remnant start times, and the duration of the remnant that starts at 1s, not pre-fork pasted ids.

Already-delivered ripple delete, ripple trim, leave-gap trim, leave-gap delete, move, lift/cut, split, extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo / ExtractAudioClip / SplitClip / leave-gap TrimClip / RippleTrimClip / rightmost RippleDeleteClips / leave-gap DeleteClip / leave-gap MoveClip / LiftClips / reject-mode MoveClips / overwrite-mode MoveClips / insert-mode MoveClips / includeLinks=false MoveClips, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND.
